title: ​Incredible Artists & Intimate Setting
text: One of the absolute highlights of our trip to Seville! The staff was so welcoming, and the artists were incredibly talented and passionate. Having an intimate, small-group audience made the performance feel truly special.
author: Reza_K

title: Excellent show in Triana.
text: Wonderful show in the Triana district of Seville. The music and dance was amazing. The venue is very intimate so you get up-close experience.
author: Drew_R

title: Drama and passion.
text: A clear welcome in anticipation of the show which turned out to be excellent. The singer and guitarist began followed by the two dancers who performed with drama and passion. I would highly recommend this experience, a great memory of a visit to Seville.
author: Peter_W

title: Incredible
text: Incredible and special, the show is worth seeing, I recommend it 100% and the staff's treatment was a 10
author: maria_j

title: Flamenco evening
text: Fantastic dancers, small venue where everyone has a great view, drink in hand. Beautiful music- both the singer and guitarist were exceptional
author: Nikki_G

title: Highly recommend for a...
text: Highly recommend for a taste of flamenco in Seville. Intimate theater where we could feel the rush of air when the dancers walked past us to get to the stage area. Show was exactly an hour, and we went to dinner and explored the neighborhood after the show.
author: Anna_L

title: Very quaint venue(about...
text: Very quaint venue(about 40 people) with a nice bar- show was amazing , one can feel raw émotion expressed by the 2 dancers .  I would highly recommend if you wish to experience authenticity.
author: LeaMaria_S

title: Wonderful experience
text: Dancers were amazing! Wish we understood the story behind it
